permitted_output: pilot usability feedback only; never comprehension scores

retention.participant_files: Local browser downloads remain on the participant's device until the participant deletes them; this prototype does not automatically delete files.
retention.operator_shared_feedback: If feedback is voluntarily shared with an operator, keep it locally for no more than seven days and delete it manually. Do not upload passage packets or raw responses to GitHub.
retention.collection: No background transmission, account, cookies, localStorage, telemetry, or remote submission.

nonclaims: SHA-256 is a tamper-evident content fingerprint, not a digital signature or proof of authorship.
Masking version labels does not prevent a knowledgeable reader from recognizing a translation.
This pilot cannot establish translation comprehension, fidelity, or a population effect.
